title: Hovercraft Backpack - 24L
description:
Crafted with a water resistant nylon fabric and vegan leather trims.

Quick access pocket on the front. 

Two side zippered pockets for your water bottle/umbrella. 

Main compartment comes with a padded laptop sleeve, pen pockets and slip pockets. 

Padded laptop compartment comes with a microsuede lining that keeps your laptop scratch-free. Fits up to a 15.6” laptop.

Makes room for all your daily essentials.

Padded shoulder straps with buckles that make it super easy to adjust the length. 

Luggage sleeve that easily secures to any Mokobara luggage. 

Size - 41 x 32 x 18 cm.

title: Check-in Luggage
description:
Unbreakable & Lightweight
Made of German Makrolon poly-carbonate shell that is flexible & strong.
Internal compression system
Cram in a week’s worth of clothes with a little help from our inbuilt compression system.
Super silent ninja wheels
Smooth Japanese Hinomoto wheels, that glide across carpets and squeaky floors. Perfect for sneaking ahead in long queues.
Magic eraser
Scuff marks are inevitable but after every trip use this eraser to wipe away scuff marks instantly.
Dust cover & Laundry bag
Between uses, slip the dust cover over your luggage before storing it. Use the laundry bag so that your clean clothes and dirty laundry stay totally separate.
TSA approved lock
Keyless TSA Lock security. This lock does not require a key for you to unlock. Simply push the latch towards the numbers to unlock. Instructions to set your lock code will be inside the luggage.
Dimensions & Weight
Check-in: 44 x 27 x 68.5 cm ; Weight: 4.6Kg ; Capacity: 71 litres

title: Briefcase
description:
DESIGNED THOUGHTFULLY FOR #GOINGPLACES.

Crafted with Vegan leather trims and water resistant nylon fabric.

Padded laptop compartment that fits up to 15.6 inches of laptop or MacBook Pro up to 16 inches, with lock strap.

Interior organisation system with pen pockets, zipper and slip pockets.

Body blended pockets on both front and back  for passport, boarding pass, cell phone and kindle.

Vegan leather handles, trims and a detachable shoulder strap for easy carrying.

Luggage sleeve secures to any Mokobara suitcase for a smooth ride.

Premium zippers

title: Radio Backpack - 22L
description:
Crafted with a premium water resistant material.

Two quick access front pockets.

Detachable key holder in the front pocket.

Front bucket compartment with a slip pocket and pen pockets. 

Spill-proof pocket for your toiletries. 

Dedicated laptop compartment with a padded laptop sleeve. 

Fits up to a 15.6” laptop and an 11" iPad Pro.

Shoulder strap buckles with lock. Designed to let you adjust the shoulder strap length easily. 

Zippered water bottle pocket. 

Sunglasses loop.

Padded shoulder straps.

Luggage sleeve.

Size - 44 x 29.5 x 17 cm

title: Travel Pillow
description:
Crafted with a fabric blend that’s soft, breathable and stretchy!

Head stabilising BASF memory foam filling. 

Ergonomic arc design for all-round comfort. 

Snap buttons which allow 3 levels of adjustment for a perfect fit.

Compresses up to 50% of its size. Compact and easy to pack.

Easy to clean. Comes with a washable sleeve that can be zipped out. 

Size when compressed: 14.5 x 14.5 x 11 cm. Size when opened: 27 x 29 x 12 cm. Weight: 0.2 kg.
